research_question: How does organizational design shape collective reasoning and decision quality in AI co-scientists?

architectures.label: Functional Multi-Agent Organization
architectures.paper_representation: shared evidence corpus / shared Paper Skills
architectures.coordination: FacilitatorAgent coordinates Perspective, Predict, Strategy, External and Decision agents
architectures.scientific_hypothesis: May perform well when tasks can be decomposed into differentiated information-processing roles.

architectures.label: Paper-Agent Committee
architectures.paper_representation: one isolated PaperAgent per retrieved paper
architectures.coordination: CommitteeChair aggregates and later facilitates deliberation among PaperAgents
architectures.context_structure: paper-level private contexts plus chair aggregation
architectures.scientific_hypothesis: May preserve heterogeneous paper-level viewpoints but incur coordination cost as evidence load increases.

architectures.label: Shared-Knowledge Umbrella Organization
architectures.coordination: Institutional Orchestrator plus Evidence Judge and Safety Supervisor
architectures.scientific_hypothesis: May reduce coordination overhead and preserve cross-paper links on high-interdependence evidence-synthesis tasks.

cross_architecture_rule: Use the same corpus, retrieval policy, base model, evidence budget, output budget and benchmark questions; vary organizational structure only.
